title: W26：介电响应律的稠密实测（ddCOSMO 任意 ε + 刚性几何）、阴离子束缚闸门与隐式模型层级对照
nature: new electronic-structure calculation at the GFN2-xTB/ddCOSMO level plus a rigid-vs-relaxed geometry control; no main-scoreboard shot

engine.geometry: gas-phase GFN2 optimisation of the neutral molecule, --opt --gfn 2 --chrg 0 --uhf 0, one geometry shared by every epsilon and every charge state (rigid scan)
engine.single_point: no --opt; --gfn 2 --chrg C --uhf U plus --cosmo EPSILON for epsilon > 1

pool.rule: rows with non-empty canonical_smiles, homo_free_eV, lumo_free_eV and total_energy_free_hartree
pool.rdkit_seed: the frozen seed column of the source table, so the gas-phase anchor is byte-comparable with the frozen layer

relaxed_geometry_subset.stratification: motif_class, proportional allocation on the 242 pool, deterministic seed 20261002
relaxed_geometry_subset.rule: for each charge state, optimise that state in the gas phase and take the 80.4 single point on its own optimum

W26-1.claim: on a ddCOSMO grid with the geometry held rigid, the solvation shift of every charge state follows the Born one-parameter form dE = -C (1 - 1/eps)

criteria_operational_notes.H1e: 只在 cationic 与 anionic 的 (molecule, state) 对上取中位

W26-2.claim: a vertical electron affinity computed in a continuum turns positive above a per-molecule gate epsilon; gas-phase anions are unbound
W26-2.bound_rule: EA(eps) = E(neutral, eps) - E(anion, eps) > 0 at a fixed geometry

criteria_operational_notes.H2a: 分母 = 气相 EA(eps=1) <= 0 的分子；分子 = 这些分子中在 eps in (1,1000] 内出现 EA(eps) > 0 的占比
criteria_operational_notes.H2b: 闸门 epsilon 的中位，仅在存在闸门的分子上取

W26-3.claim: ddCOSMO and ALPB differ at a matched epsilon, and the difference is a model difference rather than a physics difference

W26-4.note: no holds / fails verdict; the arm exists to price a future G1->G2 geometry rung

threshold_notes.H1b_origin: v6 reports 19.6 meV as an EXTRAPOLATED residual at eps = 200; W26 measures it instead
threshold_notes.H1d_origin: v6 reports the power law |dE| * eps ~ 2.1 eV; W26 tests constancy of |dE| * eps directly on the band eps in [20, 1000]
threshold_notes.H1e_origin: W24-1 re-optimised the geometry in every medium; this arm prices that choice

red_lines: no Reaxys number enters any pool or deliverable
THEMol (CC BY-NC 4.0) stays out of the delivery package
main scoreboard shots = 0 this round (cumulative stays 12)
cross-level absolute values are never compared
the frozen W24-1 tables are never modified; any reinterpretation is registered as W26 commentary
the gas-phase anchor H1f gates every other reading: if it breaks, the round is void
revision_note: 修订 2 发生在**生产运行开始之前**：当时只跑过两次冒烟（3 分子与 8 分子），242 分子的生产扫描尚未提交。 修订动机是定义缺陷，不是结果导向：第一次冒烟发现 (a) Born 拟合把首点错锚在 epsilon=2 而不是气相点，导致离子态 R2 假性塌到 0.70；(b) 冻结层锚点按原文口径必然为假，因为 w21.parse_arm 读的是 xTB --opt 日志里的**首个 ISCF 块**（输入几何），不是优化后几何。 改动清单：(1) H1b 明确为 Born 腔残余 |C_fit|/epsilon 在 epsilon=200 的取值（与 W24-1 同口径）；(2) H1c 保持实测再走量 |dE(1000)-dE(200)|；(3) H1d 的‘残余’明确为 |C_fit|-|dE(epsilon)|，带内 epsilon 属于 [20,1000]；(4) H1b/H1c/H1d 的裁决集合明确为离子曲线（阳离子+阴离子），三态合并值并列报出；(5) H1e 只在离子对上评（中性对按构造恒为 0）；(6) H1f 拆成 H1f（原文口径：优化几何单点对冻结层）与 H1g（冻结层实际口径：--opt 日志首个 ISCF 块对冻结层），其中 H1g 是本轮的复现性闸门；(7) H2a 的分母明确为‘气相电子亲和为负（未束缚）的分子’。 没有任何阈值被移动：0.99 / 0.020 eV / 0.015 eV / 0.35 / 0.05 eV / 0.50 / 40.0 / 0.15 eV 全部与修订 1 相同。

smoke_pilot_evidence.note: 生产前冒烟（probes/artifacts 已被随后覆盖，数值只作修订依据记录）
